source.note: Built 2026-10-22 from the reformatted Algebra 2 course (HS_Algebra 2 Q3-Q4 Module Formatted folders). Module and item titles, order, sub-headers, points, grading types and Wiris LTI links (quiz id + lookup uuid) were read from the product master copy export (11th-grade-algebra-2-product-master-copy-export.imscc): the course was never deployed to Canvas the old way and has no Module Maps in the formatted set, so the export is the naming authority. This is the Honors course (1200340), so the items marked Honors Only are included (Lessons 11.01, 11.02 and 13.06 and the Module 11 Summative Assessment (Honors Only)); in the export the Module 11 Honors summative is an empty 0-point assignment with no submission type, the 11.01-11.02 Honors Mid-Module Check is an empty sub-header with no item under it (omitted from the kit), and the Honors lessons have no practice assignments. The seven Module Lesson Maps pages are in an unpublished Teacher Resources module. Lessons and assignment pages are on https://optimaondemand.github.io/hs-algebra-2-honors; the one small lesson video (0.8 MB, Lesson 14.01) is served from the same site. Gradebook groups and weights (40/40/20) from the course owner; the course's teacher manual recommends 50/40/10. The bundled syllabus and teacher manual are PDFs rendered from the course's HTML front matter. No week pacing exists in the course files, so no item carries a week.
